notes: The wasm artifact is rebuilt from the bind-mounted source at container start-up, so a source edit is picked up by that service's own watcher (src/, frontend/, Cargo.toml, Cargo.lock).

secrets.name: SESSION_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.description: HS256 session signing key (base64, 32 bytes). Generated as a development placeholder; the compose entrypoint generates an ephemeral one locally if it is absent. Rotate it for any real deployment.

secrets.name: APP_TOKEN_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.description: Signing key for application API tokens (base64, 32 bytes). Generated as a development placeholder; the compose entrypoint generates an ephemeral one locally if it is absent. Rotate it for any real deployment.

secrets.name: GCORE_API_KEY
secrets.description: Gcore permanent API token (Customer Portal → Account settings → API tokens), used for the Edge Storage write path, client stats and limits. Only needed for a real FastEdge deployment; the sandbox runs against the local control-plane mock, which accepts the placeholder in .env.base44-defaults.
